operations.name: get_group
operations.description: Read a WhatsApp group: its name and description, how many members it has and who they are (each one's name, number where WhatsApp shows it, id, and admin or member), and whether you're one of its admins (QR credentials)

operations.name: create_group
operations.description: Create a WhatsApp group with you as its admin, adding the people named. Answers the new group's id and, per person, who was added and who wasn't and why (someone whose privacy settings let only their contacts add them gets the invite link instead) (QR credentials)

operations.name: rename_group
operations.description: Rename a WhatsApp group (an admin's, when the group is locked to admins) (QR credentials)

operations.name: add_group_participants
operations.description: Add people to a WhatsApp group you're an admin of. Answers, per person, whether they were added, were already in it, or weren't added and why: someone whose privacy settings let only their contacts add them, or who left recently, can join by the group's invite link instead; a number not on WhatsApp can't (QR credentials)

operations.name: remove_group_participants
operations.description: Remove people from a WhatsApp group you're an admin of. Answers, per person, whether they were removed or weren't in it (QR credentials)

operations.name: leave_group
operations.description: Leave a WhatsApp group: the account stops getting its messages and can't rejoin without an invite. A group whose last member leaves is gone (QR credentials)

operations.name: get_group_invite_link
operations.description: Get a WhatsApp group's invite link, which lets anyone who has it join (an admin's) (QR credentials)

operations.name: revoke_group_invite_link
operations.description: Revoke a WhatsApp group's invite link so it no longer lets anyone join, and get its new one (an admin's) (QR credentials)

operations.name: receive_message
operations.description: Receive incoming messages via webhook. Works with both QR scan and Cloud API credentials.

filters.include_group_messages: Also trigger when a message arrives in a group chat. Off by default: an auto-reply bot answering into groups can message many people at once. Not consulted when Only These Chats is set.
filters.include_self_chat: Also trigger on what you write in your own "Message yourself" chat on the linked phone, so you can talk to an agent from WhatsApp. What you send in any other chat, and what a NoClick node sends, never triggers. Heard whether or not Only These Chats lists it.
filters.chat_ids: Start a run only for messages in these chats; leave empty for every chat. When set, the list alone decides: a group listed here fires even with group messages off, and every chat not listed, direct or group, is ignored.

operations.name: receive_status_update
operations.description: Receive message status updates via webhook
